01 · Architecture Evolution

From Midterm Monolith to Final Web Service

Separating UI rendering, identity federation, and API persistence solves coupling while unlocking multi-client scale.

01

HTML Templates → JSON REST API

Midterm relied on Django MVT HTML views tied directly to cookies. Final delivers clean JSON endpoints under /api/v1/ with drf-spectacular Swagger docs and strict JSONRenderer in production.

MVT→REST + OpenAPI
02

Session Cookies → Keycloak OIDC

Authentication moved out of Django forms into a dedicated Keycloak 26.4 server (cde realm). Next.js acquires PKCE tokens and Django verifies RS256 JWTs locally against JWKS.

allauth cookie→OIDC PKCE + JWT
03

Single App → Decoupled Cloud Services

Storefront proxies /api to Gunicorn via Nginx or Vercel rewrites, Celery Beat polls Bakong KHQR asynchronously, and Neon PostgreSQL hosts both app & Keycloak schemas.

Monolith→Render + Vercel + Neon
Midterm BuildCoupled Django MVT + Session State
Final Web ServiceStateless DRF API + Keycloak SSO + Next.js

Rate Limiting & Production Renderer

prod.py restricts DRF to pure JSONRenderer. Scoped throttles protect critical routes: anon 120/min, user 600/min, checkout 10/min, and payment_verify 20/min.

config/settings/base.pyDRF
REST_FRAMEWORK = {
  "DEFAULT_AUTHENTICATION_CLASSES": [
    "core.authentication.KeycloakJWTAuthentication"

  "DEFAULT_SCHEMA_CLASS":
    "drf_spectacular.openapi.AutoSchema",
}
# Explicit allowlist headers (incl. guest cart token):

04 · Identity & Access Management

What is Keycloak & What We Use It For

An open-source OpenID Connect (OIDC) & OAuth 2.0 server that centralizes authentication, SSO, and RBAC outside application code.

Concept

What is Keycloak?

Keycloak 26.4
Keycloak is an enterprise Identity & Access Management (IAM) server. Instead of coding login forms, password hashing, MFA, and session cookies inside every backend, Keycloak manages identity centrally and issues RS256 JWT tokens.
Centralized Login & OIDC Standard Users enter credentials on Keycloak’s domain only; apps receive verified tokens with zero password exposure.
Built-In Security Guardrails Includes brute-force lockout (5 attempts → 900s), password policy enforcement, recovery emails & token rotation.
Social Identity Federation Plugs into Google & Telegram OIDC cleanly from the console while delivering one consistent token shape to your API.

05 · Identity Integration

Keycloak OIDC + PKCE & Django JWKS Verify

Django never touches raw user passwords — tokens are minted by Keycloak and validated in memory with PyJWT.

Click step to inspect1 / 5
5-Step Auth SequenceOIDC S256

Step 1 — Next.js OIDC + PKCE Initiation

frontend/src/lib/auth.ts
oidcConfig() & signInArgs()TypeScript
return {
  authority: `${config.keycloak.url}/realms/cde`,
  client_id: "cde-web",
  redirect_uri: `${origin}/auth/callback`,
  scope: "openid profile email",
  automaticSilentRenew: true,
  userStore: new WebStorageStateStore({ store: window.sessionStorage }),
};
// Optional social jump: extraQueryParams: { kc_idp_hint: "google" | "telegram" }
Public Client (No Client Secret)cde-web enables Standard Flow + PKCE S256 while disabling Implicit and Direct Access Grants.
Zero Password ExposureCredentials are entered exclusively on Keycloak’s domain, never posted to Next.js or Django.

Step 2 — Realm cde Security & Social Broker

infra/keycloak/import/cde-realm.json
cde Realm Policy HighlightsJSON
{
  "realm": "cde",
  "registrationEmailAsUsername": true,
  "bruteForceProtected": true,   // locks after 5 failures (900s max wait)
  "passwordPolicy": "length(8) and notUsername and notEmail",
  "accessTokenLifespan": 300,   // 5 min short-lived access token
  "revokeRefreshToken": true,   // single-use refresh token rotation
  "identityProviders": ["google", "telegram"]
}
Dual Locale & RegistrationSupports en and km locales plus self-registration and forgot-password email recovery.
Telegram & Google MappersTelegram maps tg_${CLAIM.sub} + phone/name attributes automatically on first broker login.

Step 3 — Authorization Code Exchange

/auth/callback
POST /realms/cde/protocol/openid-connect/tokenHTTP
POST /realms/cde/protocol/openid-connect/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=authorization_code
&client_id=cde-web
&code=eyJ...&redirect_uri=https://shop/auth/callback
&code_verifier=dBjftJeZ4CVP-mB92K27uhbUJU1p1r_wW1gFWFOEjXk

// Frontend attaches access_token on every API call:
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6...
PKCE Cryptographic ProofKeycloak hashes code_verifier and matches the original S256 challenge before returning tokens.
Same-Origin ProxyBecause next.config.ts proxies /api/*, cookies & guest cart tokens flow cleanly alongside JWTs.

Step 4 — Decoded Keycloak Access Token Claims

RS256 · 300s
Access Token JSON PayloadJWT
{
  "iss": "http://localhost:8080/realms/cde", // KEYCLOAK_PUBLIC_URL
  "aud": "cde-api",                           // oidc-audience-mapper
  "azp": "cde-web",                           // allowed SPA client
  "sub": "9c4b0e12-8b3d-4c88-a7f1-1d2e...",   // mapped to keycloak_id
  "email": "admin@cambodia-digital.local",
  "email_verified": true,
  "realm_access": { "roles": ["admin", "customer"] }
}
Backchannel Split URL TrickTokens carry public iss (localhost:8080) while Django fetches certs over http://keycloak:8080.
Strict Client & Audience CheckDjango rejects any JWT missing aud="cde-api" or minted for unknown azp clients.

Step 5 — Django JWKS Validation & CustomUser Sync

core/authentication.py
decode_token() & sync_user()Python
ROLE_PRIORITY = ("admin", "staff", "customer")

signing_key = _jwks_client().get_signing_key_from_jwt(token)
claims = jwt.decode(token, signing_key.key, algorithms=["RS256"],
                    issuer=settings.KEYCLOAK_ISSUER,
                    audience=settings.KEYCLOAK_AUDIENCE)
# Highest privilege wins; syncs keycloak_id, email, name & role in Postgres
user = User.objects.filter(keycloak_id=claims["sub"]).first()
# Links legacy users ONLY if email_verified is True
No Per-Request Keycloak HopPyJWKClient(cache_keys=True, lifespan=3600) caches public RSA keys locally with auto rotation.
Safe Legacy Account LinkingPre-existing users match by email only when email_verified == true to prevent account takeover.

Guide 1 — manage.py keycloak_sync on Boot

accounts/management/commands
render-start.sh → keycloak_sync.pyPython
# 1. Exchanges master KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD for admin-cli bearer token
_allow_web_urls(KEYCLOAK_WEB_URLS)     # appends URL/* to cde-web redirect & logout
_grant_realm_admin(KEYCLOAK_REALM_ADMINS)
# Looks up user by exact email → assigns client role:
#   realm-management → realm-admin  (to open /admin/cde/console/ via Google!)
Strictly Additive & SafeOnly appends missing URLs/roles and logs gracefully if a user has not logged in yet.
Shop Admin Role Notekeycloak_sync grants realm-admin for Keycloak UI; assign realm role admin for Django/Next Admin.

Guide 2 — Allow Custom Domain via CLI

scripts/kc-add-domain.sh
scripts/kc-add-domain.shbash
# Prompts silently for master password, fetches cde-web & appends new origin:
./scripts/kc-add-domain.sh https://cambodia-digital-shop.ice-tea.me

# Automatically updates in Keycloak Admin REST API:
- redirectUris               → adds https://.../*
- webOrigins                 → adds https://...
- post.logout.redirect.uris  → adds https://.../*
Fixes Redirect URI ErrorsSolves Keycloak “Invalid parameter: redirect_uri” immediately when deploying preview or custom domains.
CORS Aligned via +Setting webOrigins: ["+"] automatically authorizes origins derived from allowed redirect URIs.

Guide 3 — Snapshot & Version Realm Config

Makefile: kc-export
make kc-exportbash
# Export edited cde realm (skipping user passwords) from local Docker Keycloak:
make kc-export

# Runs under the hood:
docker compose exec keycloak /opt/keycloak/bin/kc.sh export \
  --realm cde --file /tmp/cde-realm.json --users skip
docker compose cp keycloak:/tmp/cde-realm.json infra/keycloak/cde-realm.export.json
Zero User Leakage--users skip exports clients, roles & flows cleanly without dumping user password hashes.
30-Day Theme Cache RuleWhen updating themes/cde/login, bump cde-vN.css in theme.properties to bust 30d browser cache.

11 · Async Payments & Deployment

Bakong KHQR Settlement & Cloud Topology

Background Celery workers verify NBC Bakong transactions automatically while Render, Vercel, and Neon scale cleanly.

Bakong KHQR Asynchronous Verification Flow Celery 5 Beat · Every 5 Seconds
1. CheckoutPOST /api/v1/checkout/ creates Order + locks stock
2. KHQR MD5bakong-khqr builds QR payload & 10m expiry
3. Scan & PollUser pays via any KH app; Next.js shows live status
4. Celery Beatpoll_pending_payments queries NBC API every 5s
5. Paid & AlertMarks PAID, clears stale orders & triggers email
Frontend

Vercel Next.js

  • Global edge CDN serving React 19 & Next.js 16 App Router
  • Rewrites /api/:path* & /media/:path* to API_INTERNAL_URL
  • Public OIDC config baked at build via NEXT_PUBLIC_*
Backend & Auth

Render Containers

  • cde-shop-api runs Gunicorn + Celery Worker/Beat in one image
  • cde-shop-auth runs pre-optimized Keycloak 26.4 with cde theme
  • cde-shop-redis handles Celery broker & DRF cache
Persistence

Neon PostgreSQL

  • Managed serverless Postgres connected via DATABASE_URL
  • Django owns public schema (orders, catalog, CustomUser)
  • Keycloak isolated cleanly in keycloak schema via KC_DB_SCHEMA

Key Takeaways & Architecture Recap

A modular, production-ready headless architecture combining Django REST Framework and Keycloak OIDC.

What our Django Web Service + Keycloak architecture achieves:

Clean API Decoupling: Django 5.2 + DRF serves stateless /api/v1/ JSON endpoints and drf-spectacular OpenAPI Swagger documentation.
Zero-Password Security: Keycloak 26.4 handles OIDC/PKCE S256, brute-force locks, and Google/Telegram SSO; Django verifies JWTs locally via JWKS.
Automatic User & Role Sync: CustomUser links via sub / verified email and maps admin, staff, and customer permissions automatically.
Turnkey Dev & Cloud Setup: Auto-imported cde-realm.json, make up Docker stack, kc-add-domain.sh, and keycloak_sync boot automation.
Ready for Live Demo: Storefront login → Keycloak Box Fill UI → Swagger /api/v1/docs/ → Cart & Bakong KHQR Checkout.
